name: Pole of Angling

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A 10-ft pole that becomes a fishing pole.
text: Speak one command word while holding this 10-foot pole and it becomes a fishing pole complete with hook, line and reel; a second command word restores the plain 10-foot pole. (It does nothing else in the game.)
